I’ve been working out lately. I heard everything you told me about taking care of my health. Now help me call my husband over to listen, okay? Honey, working here isn’t too hard. I’ll send the money back—count it carefully, don’t guess. While I’m away, please take good care of my parents and help check that the children do their homework properly. The boss says I can take a full three weeks off at Christmas. I’ve already bought my ticket, so come pick me up then, okay? That’s all for now. You know I love you all. I’m going to sleep—I have to work at six tomorrow morning and get up early again. After hanging up, I sighed. Who leaves home for work without missing it? Day after day, year after year, I’ve worked for my boss’s family. It’s been nearly seventeen years. I’m very grateful that the whole family has trusted me from beginning to end. I cared for the baby from birth until now, when he’s grown so big. I’ve devoted the best years of my life to this family. Now it’s time to return to Indonesia to care for my own family. That day, you all even took time off to see me off. The baby hugged me and cried so hard he could hardly stand. I hope you find another helper who loves you just as much. I hope you’ll care for her as lovingly as you cared for me. You’re always welcome to come visit me. Thank you—you’re my other family in this world.
